DefendNewest.Name: Defend against the newest attack

UI.aCybergunItOnlyWorksWhile: A cybergun: it only works while this cyberware is installed, working and healed in
UI.onAVehicleFixedDriverOr: On a vehicle: fixed (driver or autopilot), turret (anyone), pintle (a gunner aboard)
UI.theMountPointItTakesOn: The mount point it takes on a vehicle: by kind (anti-vehicle, missiles and heavy guns take a hardpoint), or set (v0.73.0)

UI.availabilityWithTheGradeAndCulturing: Availability with the grade (and culturing) counted

UI.headwareMemoryRatingMpKnowsoftsAnd: Headware memory: Rating = Mp. Knowsofts and linguasofts beyond the free jacks run from it at {memoryPerRating} Mp per point of rating.
UI.essenceWorthOfCyberwareItCan: Essence worth of cyberware it can hold
UI.attacksMadeWithThisLimbUse: Attacks made with this limb use its Strength, and its Quickness when defaulting (pick it in the Attack or attribute dialog). Its armor (below) counts only against called shots at it. Cyberware housed in it uses its capacity instead of Essence.
UI.installedItAppearsInTheWearer: Installed, it appears in the wearer's weapon list and can attack and parry. Housed in a cyberarm, it uses the arm's Strength.
UI.activesoftsAreCappedAtThisRating: Activesofts are capped at this rating
UI.blackIcThatWouldDoPhysical: Black IC that would do Physical damage do Stun; + rating dice to resist black IC, dump shock, biofeedback and overload
UI.whichToxinsItFiltersAirInhaled: Which toxins it filters: air (inhaled), blood (injected and contact) or ingested
UI.addsItsRatingInDiceTo: Adds its rating in dice to resisting toxins it filters
UI.addsToBodyForDamageResistance: Adds to Body for damage resistance only, and to unarmed Power; adds weight (the best lacing counts)
UI.smartlinkLevelATickedSmartlinkBox: Smartlink level (a ticked Smartlink box counts as level 1)
UI.eachLevelMovesARangedAttack: Each level moves a ranged attack's range band one closer
UI.addsItsRatingInDiceTo2: Adds its rating in dice to social skills
UI.eachPointLowersTheTnOf: Each point lowers the TN of hearing tests
UI.canTBeDeafenedByLoud: Can't be deafened by loud noise
UI.diceOrATnChangeFor: Dice or a TN change for a named skill, e.g. "Athletics +2; Perception TN -1" (its concentration or specialization works too)
UI.biowareCostsBodyIndexInsteadOf: Bioware costs Body Index instead of Essence
UI.grownFromTheWearerSOwn: Grown from the wearer's own tissue: needed for brain bioware; costs more
UI.itsBonusesCountOnlyWhileActive: Its bonuses count only while active; switching it off brings a crash
UI.vehicleControlRigLevel0Not: Vehicle control rig level (0 = not a control rig): jump into vehicles, rigged Reaction and initiative, Control Pool
UI.touchSpellsNeedContactNotSight: Touch spells need contact, not sight; an unwilling target is touched with a test first (v0.56.0)
UI.detectionSpellsReachMagicForceMetres: Detection spells reach Magic × Force metres; extended range further (v0.56.0)
UI.healAndTreatDrainAtThe: Heal and Treat drain at the level of the wound they heal (v0.56.0)
UI.treatWorksOnlySoonAfterThe: Treat works only soon after the wound (v0.56.0)
UI.aCritterSInnateSpellCast: A critter's innate spell: cast with its Magic (else Essence) instead of Sorcery (v0.72.0; house rule)
UI.manaBarrierPhysicalBarrierRaisesA: Mana Barrier / Physical Barrier: raises a barrier of the spell's Force while sustained (v0.72.0; house rule)
UI.effectsWhileItLastsIncreaseReflexes: Effects while it lasts (Increase Reflexes, Increase [Attribute], Armor...)
UI.addedToEveryTestTheTarget: Added to every test the target makes
UI.addedToTestsToNoticeThe: Added to tests to notice the target
UI.addedToAttacksAndSpellsAgainst: Added to attacks and spells against the target
UI.eachSuccessOrStepOfSuccesses: Each success (or step of successes) adds the values again, up to the Force
UI.theseGoOnTheTargetThe: These go on the target (the caster with no target) once the spell succeeds (a resisted spell: by net successes) and come off when it is dropped. Reflexes from spells don't stack with wired, boosted or adept reflexes; a permanent spell keeps them once it takes.
UI.normalWeaponsFirePoisonsPathogensAge: normal weapons, fire, poisons, pathogens, age (v0.56.0)
UI.itsMeleeBlowsPassTheDisease: Its melee blows pass the disease on when they do Physical damage: Power = the rating above, at the damage level above (v0.48.0).
UI.immunityToNormalWeaponsArmorOf: Immunity to normal weapons: armor of Essence × {immunityArmorPerEssence} against non-magical attacks. Fire: no fire damage or burning. Poisons: toxins do nothing. Pathogens: diseases do nothing (v0.56.0).
UI.v0560OnTheTarget: v0.56.0: on the target while the power lasts
UI.leftAt0Or1These: Left at 0 (or ×1), these come from the Special: {powerModDefaults}. The effect lasts until the user drops it (v0.56.0).
UI.aSustainedPowerItsEffectLasts: A sustained power: its effect lasts until dropped (v0.45.0)
UI.multiplyTheChangesByTheNet: Multiply the changes by the net successes (capped)
UI.withNetSuccessesOnlyAsIts: With Net successes only as its effect, the changes go on the target (on the user with no target) when it takes effect, and last while the user keeps it up: the user's sheet lists it with Drop; it drops if the user is knocked out.
UI.theDiceRolledAreAlsoThe: The dice rolled are also the power's rating: the TN for the target's resistance test. Net successes stage damage like a combat spell (no armor), or just measure the effect. Special: allergies add a TN penalty while exposed (and damage on contact, by severity); a vulnerability stages up weapons of that material, past immunity, and can't be regenerated; Essence loss takes Essence over time; Essence drain moves Essence on a hit; regeneration heals Physical damage each Combat Turn; dual-natured beings are always astrally active.
UI.tiedToSpellSpiritKindType: Tied to (spell, spirit kind/type or weapon name)
UI.spellFociAddDiceToSorcery: Spell foci add dice to Sorcery for their category or named spell; spirit foci to Conjuring for their spirit kind or type; weapon foci to melee attacks with the named weapon and to astral attacks; a power focus raises the Magic used for drain and adds its rating to the Spell Pool (as a house rule: dice on Sorcery and Conjuring). A sustaining focus holds one sustained spell up to its rating, with no TN penalty. Only the best focus of each type counts. Bonding Karma × rating: a named spell 1, a spell category 3, spirit 2, power 5, weapon 4 (small) or 5 (large); a spell lock 1 in all.
UI.anEffectTheSystemAppliesScaled: An effect the system applies, scaled by the power's level (v0.39.0)
UI.killingHandsUnarmedBlowsDoPhysical: Killing hands: unarmed blows do Physical damage (level 1 L, 2 M, 3 S, 4 D). Combat sense: + level dice to dodge, melee defense and surprise. Pain resistance: ignores level boxes for wound modifiers. Enhanced perception: + level dice to Perception. Astral perception: lets the adept perceive astrally. Rapid healing: + level dice to natural healing. Distance strike: unarmed blows reach Magic metres (no counterattack). Spell resistance: + level dice to resist spells and powers. Improved senses: the sense chosen (v0.56.0).
UI.aWirelessTransceiverHowFarA: A wireless transceiver: how far a cellular or relayed link reaches (0 = none)
UI.aDeckWithoutAsistMeatSpeed: A deck without ASIST: meat-speed initiative, less Hacking Pool, no hot sim, safe from black IC and dump shock
UI.anOtakuSLivingPersonaThe: An otaku's living persona: the ratings come from the otaku's attributes (house rule: {otakuState})
UI.whatItCostTheBuilderCounts: What it cost (the builder counts it)
UI.mpLoadedPerCombatTurnWhen: Mp loaded per Combat Turn when swapping memory jacked in (0 = its I/O speed)
UI.onEnteringAHostMpcpVs: On entering a host: MPCP vs its Security Value; it works (+Reaction, +Hacking Pool there) or fights the sculpting (+TN there)
UI.jacksForPassengersWhoRideAlong: Jacks for passengers who ride along (black IC and dump shock reach them too)
UI.damageToTheDeckItselfBlaster: Damage to the deck itself (blaster, sparky, ripper, trace and burn) until repaired
UI.erasedByATarPitUntick: Erased by a tar pit: untick once you have a copy again
UI.anOtakuSComplexFormUses: An otaku's complex form: uses no memory and can't be erased (GM; otaku learn them from the Matrix section)
UI.attackUtilitiesDealPowerRatingAt: Attack utilities deal Power = rating at their damage level. Other utilities lower a system test's TN by their rating. Sleaze adds to the Detection Factor. Medic repairs the persona. Book size (rating² × multiplier
UI.aRemoteControlDeckJumpInto: A remote control deck: jump into vehicles you are not aboard, and hold rating × {rcdPerRating} drones
UI.howFarItsSignalReaches0: How far its signal reaches (0 = its RCD rating)
UI.aJammerJamsRemoteLinksIts: A jammer: jams remote links (its rating vs the link's signal)
UI.anAmmunitionClipReloadOnA: An ammunition clip: Reload on a weapon offers it
UI.roundsPerClip0FillsThe: Rounds per clip (0 = fills the weapon)
UI.addsThisManyDiceToFirst: Adds this many dice to first aid
UI.aSlapPatchStimTranqTrauma: A slap patch: stim, tranq, trauma or antidote (Apply on the Gear tab)
UI.bulkInCargoFactorUnitsEach: Bulk in Cargo Factor units, each (a vehicle's CF)
UI.aProgrammingSuiteHelpsWritePrograms: A programming suite: helps write programs (and design deck parts)
UI.aChameleonSuitOrThermalMasking: A chameleon suit or thermal masking: hides the wearer from sensors
UI.diceOrATnChangeFor2: Dice or a TN change for a named skill while carried, e.g. "Athletics +2" (climbing gear)
UI.aRadioItsSignalRatingA: A radio: its signal rating (a jammer of at least this rating blocks it)
UI.aSinOrALicencePermit: A SIN or a licence (permit) the owner carries
UI.aFakeSRatingTheChecker: A fake's rating: the checker rolls against it

UI.aHermeticLibraryCircleOrShamanic: A hermetic library, circle or shamanic lodge (v0.39.0)
UI.libraryConjuringOrSorceryCircleIts: Library: conjuring or sorcery. Circle: its element. Lodge: its totem. Empty = any
UI.payToBuildItOrRaise: Pay to build it or raise its rating
UI.anExplosiveChargeItsPower0: An explosive charge: its Power (0 = not an explosive). Setting it is a Demolitions test
UI.againstABarrierItIsSet: Against a barrier it is set on: × the shaped multiplier, no blast beyond it

UI.takeUsesADoseTheBonuses: Take uses a dose: the bonuses last for the duration, then the crash (Stun) is resisted like a toxin. Its Power and level above are for an overdose (Expose).
UI.howItSpreadsFromACarrier: How it spreads from a carrier (v0.48.0)
UI.exposeTheVictimResistsWithBody: Expose: the victim resists with Body; damage left means infected. After the incubation it tests every interval: damage, or a clean test toward recovery.

UI.itSSActionPhaseLeft: It's {name}'s action phase: {label} left. Buttons that need more are greyed.
UI.toolsWhereElse: This window opens with Alt+T, the SR2e tools button in the Actors sidebar, the toolbox in the toolbar on the left (while a scene is shown) and the guide.
UI.shopMarkHint: In the shop: players see it when the shop shows only what you mark (Configure Settings)
UI.cancelOrderRefund: Cancel the order (the money comes back)
UI.openOrdersHint: Things bought from the shop or a find card, on their way. They arrive when game time passes; each is also under Under way on its character's sheet.
UI.newEntryIntro: Type the numbers from your own book. The system ships no book data, and nothing here is shared outside your world.
UI.newEntryReviewNote: A player sent this. Check it against the book, change what needs changing, then save it (that approves the request), or decline it in the Requests tab.
UI.newEntryPastePlaceholder: Name, then the numbers and codes, e.g. "Example pistol 5 15(c) SA 9M 2 3/24 hrs 450 1"
UI.newEntryPasteHint: Only the name, numbers and codes are read (damage, Availability, cost…). Words it doesn't know are shown, never kept.
UI.newEntryDescriptionHint: A line in your own words: don't copy the book's text.
UI.newEntryNoCharacter: You need a character of your own to send a new entry from.
UI.newEntryButtonHint: Not in the list? Make a new entry from your own book.
UI.reviewEntryHint: Open the new entry to check and edit it before it goes into the catalogue
UI.catalogueBookText: Templates and catalogue files hold what you typed from your books: keep them for your own group, and don't share or publish book text.
UI.codexMissing: This entry isn’t in your Catalogue (any more).
UI.codexPick: Pick an entry on the left to see its page.
UI.codexButtonHint: Browse everything you can get, a page per entry
UI.vehicleCostHint: What it costs new in nuyen (0 = no price set: players can’t buy it in the shop).
UI.vehicleNoPrice: No price set: players can’t buy it in the shop.
UI.permitGmTicks: The GM ticks this; players use Get a permit…
UI.buyFormulaHint: Buy this spell's formula (found and bought like gear)
UI.learnFormulaHint: Learn the spell from this formula (the learning test and Good Karma)
UI.formulaHint: A spell formula teaches its spell at up to its Force. Learning from the other tradition's formula is harder and slower.
UI.carriedHint: Carried on the person. Left behind, it has no weight, a search doesn't find it, and it can't be used, drawn or worn until it is carried again.
UI.leftBehindHint: Left behind: no weight, not found by a search, can't be used.

UI.undoDescriptionHint: Put the fields back as they were and stop reading these accessories from the description.

UI.tweakOnHint: Untick to keep the tweak without it counting.
UI.noTweaksHint: No tweaks. Press + for a bespoke modifier the rules don't cover: an attribute, Reaction, initiative dice, a pool, a skill's dice or TN, damage Power, armor, or a note.
UI.tweaksOffHint: Custom tweaks are switched off in the house rules: these are kept but don't count.

rulesSource.Name: Rules source
rulesSource.Hint: SR2E Book Rules: the system's default rules. SR2E Unified Rules Revamp: an alternate ruleset laid over them; it follows the community document Shadowrun Classic: Unified Rule Revamp (v1.2), with a few house rules where it is silent. Your house rules still win over either. Players see the change at once.

houseRulesMenu.Name: House rules
houseRulesMenu.Label: Edit house rules
houseRulesMenu.Hint: Change SR2e rule values (target numbers, actions, melee, healing…) for this world.

defendPrompt.Name: When you are attacked or hit
defendPrompt.Hint: For characters you own: open the Defend or Resist dialog for you, just notify you, or do nothing (use the buttons on the card).

foldDice.Name: Fold dice on chat cards
foldDice.Hint: Show each test's dice folded away under its summary line (click to open). Applies to new cards, or all after a reload.

floatingDamage.Name: Floating damage numbers
floatingDamage.Hint: Show boxes of damage and healing floating over tokens.

autoApplyGm.Name: Apply players' GM-only changes by themselves
autoApplyGm.Hint: When a player's test changes something only the GM can, the logged-in GM's client applies a few harmless kinds at once instead of waiting for a click on Apply (GM): a jam or hold on what the player owns, a sensor lock for their own vehicle, and boxes on their own character. Security tallies, site and host changes (alerts, passcodes, files), cleansing, drone links, doors, healing or damage on others, nuyen, surgery, possession and effects always wait for the GM. The system posts an Apply (GM) card only for what the player doesn't own, so in practice almost every card still waits for your click. Each change made by itself is listed in a whispered note. Off by default.

wardsStopAstral.Name: Ward regions stop astral forms
wardsStopAstral.Hint: A region linked to a ward or barrier (its config window, SR2e environment): anything with an astral presence (projecting magicians, spirits, dual-natured critters) can't move across its edge while its rating is above 0. A physical barrier always stops bodies. The GM's own moves only warn.

regionDetect.Name: Camera and sensor regions
regionDetect.Hint: When someone walks into a region a site's camera or sensor watches: tell the GM with a Detection test button, roll the test at once, or do nothing.

autoResistNpc.Name: NPCs resist damage by themselves
autoResistNpc.Hint: The GM's client rolls the damage resistance (and spell resistance) of characters no logged-in player owns as soon as the card appears, with no pool dice: on a GM's card, or on a player's card that comes from their own character. Blasts wait for Resist all… on the card.

approvalQueue.Name: Players' purchases and Karma wait for the GM
approvalQueue.Hint: A player buying, adding or learning something, or spending Karma, sends a request instead; the GM approves or declines it in the GM panel (Requests). This applies to every character that isn't in the creation wizard, including one with no creation record yet. Building a character in the wizard doesn't wait.

rollPrivacyMenu.Name: Roll privacy by kind of test
rollPrivacyMenu.Label: Set roll privacy
rollPrivacyMenu.Hint: Who sees your attacks, spells, Matrix tests, healing and other tests by default.

turnPing.Name: Turn pings
turnPing.Hint: When a combatant's turn comes, ping their token on your map (if you can see it), and tell you if it is one of your characters.

hoverCard.Name: Pools on token hover
hoverCard.Hint: Hovering over a token you own (any token, for the GM) shows its pools, monitors, initiative and state.

soundCues.Name: Sound cues
soundCues.Hint: Play a sound on your turn, when one of your characters is attacked or hit, on a disaster, and (GM) when a security alert goes up. The sounds are set below.

moduleSupport.Name: Support for Item Piles and Health Estimate
moduleSupport.Hint: When those modules are active, SR2e tells them where nuyen, prices, quantities and the condition monitor are. Turn off to set them up by hand.

moduleSupportLook.Name: One look for module windows
moduleSupportLook.Hint: With Foundry's dark colour scheme, each user's Monk's Enhanced Journal gets its own dark backgrounds once, so the window isn't half light and half dark. Only settings still at Monk's default are changed, and a user's own choice is kept.

diceColours.Name: Dice colours on chat cards
diceColours.Hint: Colourblind-safe uses blue and orange with shapes as well as colour; high contrast uses black and white.

dsnColours.Name: Dice So Nice: SR2e colours
dsnColours.Hint: With the Dice So Nice module: roll SR2e tests in the SR2e colour set, Rule of Six re-rolls in gold.

skillWebMenu.Name: Skill Web
skillWebMenu.Label: Edit the Skill Web
skillWebMenu.Hint: Links between skills for defaulting: each step adds to the TN.

defaultArt.Hint: New actors get the system's own picture and token (by metatype, figure and archetype; vehicle type; spirit kind; critter) while they have Foundry's stand-in, and it follows their changes. A picture set by hand or found by name is kept.
defaultArt.Name: Default token art

keepErrors.Name: Keep recent errors for bug reports
keepErrors.Hint: Keeps the system's last few console errors in this browser for the "Report a bug" text (nothing is sent anywhere). Turn off if you debug other modules: while it is on, the browser console shows the sr2e file as the source of every warning. Reload after changing it.

bugReportMenu.Name: Report a bug
bugReportMenu.Label: Report a bug
bugReportMenu.Hint: Copy a text with your versions, modules, rules settings and the system's recent errors, ready to paste into a GitHub issue. Nothing is sent by itself.

lookTheme.Name: Look: theme
lookTheme.Hint: SR2e's own windows and chat cards: Street (dark), Corp (shaded light) or High contrast. Foundry's sidebar keeps its own look.

lookPreset.Name: Look: colour preset
lookPreset.Hint: The accent colour of the windows, links, tabs and dice that hit.

windowOpacity.Name: Look: window opacity (%)
windowOpacity.Hint: 100 is solid (best to read). Lower lets the map show through the windows.

textScale.Name: Look: text size (%)
textScale.Hint: The size of everything inside SR2e's windows and chat cards.

reducedMotion.Name: Look: reduced motion
reducedMotion.Hint: No glows, fades or flashes in SR2e's windows (your system's reduced-motion setting is always honoured too).

portraitFolder.Name: Portrait folder
portraitFolder.Hint: A folder in your Data folder (for example avatars). A character named "Rook" takes avatars/Rook.webp (or .png, .jpg) as its picture and token while those are the default pictures. A picture set by hand is kept.

portraitTokens.Name: Portraits for tokens too
portraitTokens.Hint: The portrait found by name also becomes the token picture (the prototype and linked tokens on the map) while it's the default.

sheetLayout.Name: Sheets: layout
sheetLayout.Hint: How character, NPC and spirit sheets are laid out for you: Tabs; Tabs with an always-open Combat column on the right; or Compact, one folding column for narrow windows. You can also switch it from the bar at the top of a sheet.

Choices.combat: Combat column (tabs plus an always-open combat column)
Choices.compact: Compact (one folding column, for narrow windows)

numberSteppers.Name: Sheets: − / + on numbers
numberSteppers.Hint: Small − and + buttons beside the numbers you change in play (ratings, quantities, damage, pool dice in roll dialogs). The scroll wheel also changes a number while it has the cursor.

rememberRolls.Name: Roll dialogs: remember my last choices
rememberRolls.Hint: Force, pool dice and similar choices come back the next time you open the same roll for the same spell or skill (weapons always remember theirs).

rememberWindows.Name: Windows: remember size and place
rememberWindows.Hint: SR2e's sheets and windows open where you left them, at the size you left them (on this computer).

groupNotes.Name: Notifications: group bursts
groupNotes.Hint: Several SR2e notices at once become one, and the same notice again shows ×2, ×3… instead of piling up.

attacked.Name: Sound: One of your characters is attacked or hit

alarm.Name: Sound: GM: a security alert goes up

shopList.Name: Shop: what players see
shopList.Hint: What the Add window (the shop) lists for players on its buying tabs (weapons, armor, gear, ware, foci, decks, programs, kits): every entry (templates, world items, compendiums), only your own catalogue (your templates, world items and kits), or only what you tick in the shop window's Shop column (and kits). The GM always sees everything.

Choices.marked: Only what I mark "in the shop"

shopForbidden.Name: Shop: forbidden things on sale
shopForbidden.Hint: Off: items whose legality is Forbidden are hidden from players in the shop. On: they are listed too (with their legality).

Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__lifestyle__buyLater: Lifestyles can be bought outright after creation (at the creation price)
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__lifestyle__creditPaidMon: Buying outright: whole months already paid ahead come off the price
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__lifestyle__keepOnLevelCh: Changing the lifestyle level keeps it owned outright
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__training__keepSpecializa: A new skill learned with training time keeps the specialization typed in the picker
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__skillCost__agree: Skill Karma bands: the + Add picker and Spend Karma read the same attribute rating
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__skillCost__basis: …that rating is natural (Reaction from natural Quickness and Intelligence) or augmented
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__racialFloor__mode: Racial modifiers below 1: floor at the minimum, warn only, or off (old)
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__npcs__threatRating: NPC generator: sets a Threat Rating by Threat Level
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__npcs__professionalFromTa: NPC generator: Professional Rating from the generator table (old, 0–5) instead of 1–4
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__npcs__karmaPool: NPC generator: Karma Pool for no one (SR2 grunts), single NPCs only, or all (old)
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__npcs__handMadeKarmaPool: A new hand-made NPC's Karma Pool (characters keep 1)
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__metatypes__open: Metatypes added in the house rules can be picked (an unknown one rules as Human)
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__skillNames__canonical: One name per skill (Rotorcraft → Rotor Aircraft, etc.; old names still match)
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__qualities__exceptionalAt: Edge 'Exceptional Attribute' (target an attribute): +1 to its racial maximum
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__qualities__surplusFlaws_: Creation: flaw points beyond the edges buy extra… (house rule)
…attribute or skill points per flaw point
Rule.CHARACTERS_V73__qualities__karmaAboveRac: Karma can raise an attribute past its racial maximum (up to the augmented maximum) at a dearer rate (SR3?)
Rule.BOOK_V78__legwork__mode: Legwork: the book's TNs (2–14, specialty −2, fixer −3) with extra dice for a closer contact, or the old TNs (−1 TN per contact level)
Rule.BOOK_V78__flash__mode: Flash grenades: +6 TN falling off with distance for 5 Combat Turns (Body test shortens it; the book), or the old blind status
Rule.BOOK_V78__patches__stim: Stim patch wears off in 2D6 minutes (the book), or rating hours (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__patches__tranq: Tranq patch: opposed (patch rating vs Body; the book), or Body vs the rating (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__toxinBioware: Toxin extractor and tracheal filter lower the toxin's Power (the book), or add dice (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__symbiotes__mode: Symbiotes shorten natural healing time (90/70/50%; the book), or add healing dice (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__encephalon__mode: Encephalon: Intelligence bonus and a Task Pool (Shadowtech), or + rating dice (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__senseAllowance__enabled: Enhancements built into cybereyes (up to 0.5) and cyberears (one of 0.2) cost no extra Essence (importer)
Rule.BOOK_V78__manaBarrier__spells: Casting across a mana barrier: its rating adds to the caster's TN (the book), or to the target's resistance dice (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__manaBarrier__rating: Mana Barrier spell: rating = half its Force (the book), or its Force (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__invisibility__mode: Seeing through Invisibility: Perception vs 2 × the caster's successes (the book), or Intelligence vs the Force (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__focusKarma__mode: Focus bonding Karma: the book's table (category 3, spirit 2, weapon 4/5, spell lock 1 flat), or the old flat table
Rule.BOOK_V78__powerFocus: Power focus: raises Magic for drain and adds Spell Pool dice (the book), or adds Sorcery and Conjuring dice (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__insectFlesh__mode: Insect flesh forms: soldiers host + Force, workers host − 1 (the book), or host + half Force (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__critterToxins__mode: Immunity to poisons and pathogens: + 2 × Essence resistance dice (the book), or no effect at all (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__paralysis__mode: Paralyzing Touch lowers Quickness by Essence for 2D6 minutes (the book), or no actions for some Combat Turns (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__combatSense: Adept Combat Sense adds Combat Pool dice (the book), or dice on dodge, melee defense and surprise (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__spellResistanceVsPowers: Magic (spell) resistance also helps against critter powers (old; the book: spells only)
Rule.BOOK_V78__allergy__mode: Allergies: the book's Nuisance/Mild/Severe/Extreme (Severe and Extreme: +2 Power of weapons of the substance), or the old table
Rule.BOOK_V78__tamper__mode: Anti-tamper alarms add their rating to the casing TN, 0 successes trips them (the book), or the old opposed tamper roll
Rule.BOOK_V78__voiceLocks: Voice locks: only a voice-deception device beats them (the book), or Electronics at +2 (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__barriers__mode: Damaging barriers: the book's steps against a doubled rating (holes; doors), or Power − rating off the rating (old)
Rule.BOOK_V78__adaptation: Vehicle adaptation: remote 2,500¥ × Body, rigger 2,800¥ on top (the notes' text), or one rigger adaptation at 2,500¥ × Body (old)
Rule.COMBAT_V61__monowhip__tn: Monofilament whip: the wielder's whip check TN
Rule.BOOK_V78__manaBarrier__wards: Casting across a ward: its rating as the target's resistance dice (as before), or on the caster's TN
Rule.BOOK_V78__riggerAdaptationCost: Rigger adaptation price (¥, on top of the remote adaptation)
Rule.DOCS_V79__socialDesired__mode: Social tests: the book's desired-result scale (advantageous −2 … disastrous +6, one pick), or the old situation checkboxes
Rule.DOCS_V79__socialInfluence__mode: Etiquette, Leadership and Negotiation: one-sided (skill vs their attribute, one success passes; SRII p180-182), or opposed (both roll; old). Negotiating pay stays opposed
Rule.DOCS_V79__skillKarma__mode: Skill Karma: the book table (general × 2, concentration × 1.5, specialization × 1, new rating), or the old bands by the linked attribute (× 1.5 / 2 / 2.5)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedReload: Reloading: a clip is Remove + Insert (two Simple Actions; a smartgun ejects free), other feeds a Complex Action (SRII), or one Simple Action for any reload (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedPoolCap: Combat Pool on an attack (and the melee defender's test): at most the skill's rating (SRII), or no cap (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedStrengthRange: Bows, crossbows, shuriken and grenades left on the default ×1/2/3/5: the book's row by name (SRII), or the item's own (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedRecoil: Recoil: only a single first shot is free (burst +3 / +6, full auto +1 per round; SRII), or the first round of the phase is always free (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedFlechette__mode: Flechette: +1 level only vs no armor, vs armor the higher of ballistic/impact doubled (SRII), or always +1 level and armor × 2 (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedScatter__mode: Grenade scatter: by type, standard 1D6 / aerodynamic 2D6 / launcher 3D6 (SRII), or 1–4D6 by range band (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__rangedSurprise__mode: Surprise: a surprise turn in order of successes, nobody acts against someone with more (SRII), or the losers lose the first pass (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__riggerDumpShock__mode: Rigger dump shock from a remote control deck: (RCD rating + 4)S Stun resisted with Body (Rigger 2), or Willpower vs 6, M Stun (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__signalFlux__base: Base flux of a remote control deck with no signal of its own: 2 (Rigger 2 flux rating table), or the deck's rating (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__magicPool__size: Spell Pool: the Sorcery rating (+ power focus; SR2 p85), or (Intelligence + Willpower + Magic) ÷ 3 (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__magicPool__castingCap: Spell Pool dice on a casting test: at most the Magic rating (SR2 p85), or no limit (old)
Rule.MAGIC__spellDefenseSpentOnUse: Spell defense dice are used up when they protect someone (SR2 p132; off: they help every resistance test that turn, old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__vehCrashLevel: Crash damage level by speed (1–20 L, 21–60 M, 61–200 S, 201+ D; Rigger 2), or always the fixed level (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__vehRamLevel: Ramming damage level by the rammer's speed, the rammer at the same level (Rigger 2), or M / S above half Speed with the rammer a level lower (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__vehMountRecoil__mode: Mounted recoil: fixed and turret mounts halve it, pintle 2 and ring 6 compensation (Rigger 2), or fixed and turret mounts ignore it (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__vehSensorTable__mode: Sensor tests: offer Rigger 2's line of sight, urban, fog, terrain and spirit rows, or not (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__vehRepair__mode: Vehicle repair: any success fixes it all, 16 hours per box ÷ successes (Rigger 2), or boxes per success (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__healing: Physical healing: in stages, one wound level per Body test (SRII Healing Table: TN 4/6/8/10, 24 h/10/20/30 days ÷ successes), or per box (old: 24 h per box ÷ successes)
Rule.DOCS_V79__healingGate: Physical healing: self-recovery test first (natural Body vs 2/4/6; failed or Deadly needs a doctor; SRII Wound Table), or none (old)
Rule.DOCS_V79__doctoring: Physical healing with a doctor: the SRII Doctoring Table (intensive −2, not in hospital +2, magician +2, natural Body and Willpower), or the old care rows and lifestyle home care
Rule.DOCS_V79__firstAidMods: First aid: the SRII First Aid Table modifiers (no medkit +4, bad/terrible +1/+3, magician +2, natural Body), or the medkit's rating as dice (old)
Rule.URR_V80__coreCriticals: Test cards count critical successes (6 or more over the TN; the GM may grant a bonus)
Rule.URR_V80__coreTnPresets: Roll dialogs offer the standard difficulty table (Simple 2 … Nearly impossible 10)
Rule.URR_V80__coreKnowledgeTest: Knowledge tests: the knowledge table (TN 3/5/8/12) and what the successes give
Rule.URR_V80__coreTies: Opposed perception and social ties: a stand-off (book), or the side that made the test wins (with 1+ success)
Rule.URR_V80__coreKarmaDice: Karma Pool can buy extra dice for a skill or attribute test (1 point a die)
Rule.URR_V80__coreStartPoolByMeta: Metahumans start with a bigger Karma Pool (when the creation wizard finishes)
Rule.URR_V80__coreKarmaGrowth: Karma Pool growth: per career Karma (book), or each award's first point to the pool
Rule.URR_V80__coreAwardPool: …per award: points to the Karma Pool
Rule.URR_V80__coreAwardGood: …then points to Good Karma, and round again
Rule.URR_V80__coreMetaMax: Natural maximums from the URR table (dwarf Quickness 5, troll Willpower 5)
Rule.URR_V80__coreEssenceFloor: Magic capped at Essence rounded down (book: rounded up)
Rule.URR_V80__coreWebArrows: Skill Web: a link written "A > B" is one-way
Rule.URR_V80__coreWebAttributes: Skill Web: defaulting to an attribute follows its links (+2 a step; no link: the flat TN)
Rule.URR_V80__coreSubSkillDefault: Without the general skill, default from its concentration or specialization
Rule.URR_V80__coreSpecDefaultTn: …from a specialization: TN + (on top of the concentration's)
Rule.URR_V80__coreLanguageKarma: Raising a language: Karma × new rating (0 = the knowledge bands)
Rule.URR_V80__coreTraining: Training time: days by rating (book), or Karma × 8 hours, an instructor at rating + 2
Rule.URR_V80__coreTrainDailyHours: …hours trained a day (or Willpower, if more)
Rule.URR_V80__coreInstructorMargin: …instructor's skill at least the new rating +
Rule.URR_V80__coreHaggleTn: Haggling: the seller's TN is fixed (book), or the buyer's Intelligence
Rule.STUN_OVERFLOW_PER_PHYSICAL_BOX: Stun boxes past a full track per Physical box (the book 2; the Revamp 1)
Rule.URR_V80__hsDeathPastOverflow: Death only one box past a full Overflow row (more than 10 + Body)
Rule.URR_V80__hsBleedMinutes: Dying: minutes of game time per extra box (0 = every Body Combat Turns, the book)
Rule.URR_V80__hsSelfStabilise: Failed first aid on the dying: the patient rolls natural Body to stabilise
Rule.URR_V80__hsTraumaPatch: Trauma patch: stabilises outright (book), or a natural Body test vs 4 + dermal armor / blood filter
Rule.URR_V80__hsTraumaPatchTn: Trauma patch Body test: base TN
Rule.URR_V80__hsStunRecovery: Stun recovery: Body vs 2/4/6/8 (book), or the higher of Body and Willpower vs 2 + wound modifiers
Rule.URR_V80__hsFirstAid: First aid: 1 box per success, at most half (book), or one wound level (Deadly: stabilise only)
Rule.URR_V80__hsFirstAidTime: First aid card shows the treatment time (10/20/30 minutes ÷ successes)
Rule.URR_V80__hsFirstAidRetry: First aid again on the same wound by a healer with higher Biotech
Rule.URR_V80__hsMagicLossUntreated: First aid without the magician +2 calls for a Magic loss test
Rule.URR_V80__hsDeadlyIntensive: A Deadly wound heals only in intensive care
Rule.URR_V80__hsOverdose: Overdose: +1 Power per active dose (book), or the second dose +1 level, then +1 Power a dose
Rule.METATYPES__types__troll__run: Troll running multiplier (the book 3; the Revamp 2)
Rule.URR_V80__hsBreathHold: Hold breath for a while (seconds per point of Body) before drowning counts
Rule.URR_V80__hsBreathSecondsPerBody: Held breath: seconds per point of Body
Rule.URR_V80__hsAthletics: Climb, jump and swim distances: per success (book), or by Fitness and Quickness
Rule.URR_V80__hsFalling: Falling: Power = metres, Serious (book), or half the metres with the level by height, no armor
Rule.URR_V80__hsVisibleArmor: Social tests: offer the visible-armor-in-a-luxury-setting row
Rule.URR_V80__hsVisibleArmorTn: Visible armor in a luxury setting: TN modifier
Rule.URR_V80__cbtTies: Initiative ties: Reaction then Quickness (book), or Reaction then natural Reaction (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtDefense: Ranged defense: dodge with the Combat Pool (book), or no dodge: pool dice in the resistance test, clean miss, net staging (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtKnockdown: Knockdown: Body vs the soak TN when Power beats Body (book), or after any damage, 2/3/4 successes for L/M/S, staggering (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtReload: Cylinders and internal magazines: the house rounds per action (book), or Quickness rounds; break action whole (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtTracers: Tracers: −1 per earlier burst (book), or full auto only, −1 per third round, no Power (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtShotgun: Shotguns: always spread (book), or slugs unless loaded with shot; the cone doubles every choke metres (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtScatter: Scatter per success: 2 m for all (book), or aerodynamic and launcher 4 m, rockets and missiles 2D6 −1 m (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtBlastStaging: A blast's attack successes stage its damage (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtArmorPool: Heavy armor lowers Quickness (book), or ballistic over Quickness costs Combat Pool dice (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtArmorLayers: Best armor plus half: only the next piece adds half (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__cbtGradedCover: Graded cover rows count as partial cover (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__vehCpCap: Control Pool on driving tests: any dice, or at most the driving skill
Rule.URR_V80__vehCpGunnery: A jumped-in driver's gunnery: Control Pool, or Combat Pool
Rule.URR_V80__vehCpResist: A jumped-in rigger adds Control Pool dice to the vehicle's damage resistance
Rule.URR_V80__vehFeedback__mode: Rigger feedback: every hit (Willpower vs Power, Stun), or only Serious 6M / Deadly 6S (Body, Physical)
Rule.URR_V80__vehDamage__mode: Weapon damage to vehicles: book (half Power, a level down), or URR (Power less Body + Armor, staged down by Body)
Rule.URR_V80__vehPassengers: People aboard: hurt by every hit, or only by impacts (crash, ram) at the vehicle's level
Rule.URR_V80__vehOccupantArmor: Shooting someone inside: the vehicle's Armor protects, or the higher of Body and Armor
Rule.URR_V80__vehImpact: Crashes and rams: book (Body + speed ÷ 10), or URR (ramming speed ÷ 10 rounded up, rammer less Body + half Armor)
Rule.URR_V80__vehDamageSpeed__mode: Damage lowers a vehicle's Speed (Moderate ×0.75, Serious ×0.5)
Rule.URR_V80__vehGunnery__mode: Mounted guns at vehicles: moving modifiers, or speed difference and target size
Rule.URR_V80__vehMountHeavy: Heavy weapon recoil on a vehicle mount: doubled, or not doubled
Rule.URR_V80__vehRepairTn__mode: Vehicle repair TN: flat, or by the worst damage (2/4/6/8)
Rule.URR_V80__dsLinkIntercept: Intercepting a drone link: the link skill vs the encryption, or decrypt first, then deck rating vs the target deck + 3
Rule.URR_V80__dsRadioDecrypt: Listening in on encrypted radio: Electronics vs the encryption, or vs encryption + 3 needing half the encryption in successes
Rule.URR_V80__dsLockCasing: Maglock casings: the casing rating, or by lock type (card reader double, print or retinal scanner +2)
Rule.URR_V80__dsPasskey: Passkeys: the rating replaces the skill, or the rating vs the card reader's
Rule.URR_V80__dsSequencer: Sequencers: the rating replaces the skill, or an opposed test against the keypad
Rule.URR_V80__dsMadScan: Weapon detectors: a test per item, or one roll that turns up every weapon up to the highest die
Rule.URR_V80__dsDumpDisorient: Dump shock disorients (+2 TN, 10 turns ÷ Willpower successes)
Rule.URR_V80__dsCommsEccm: A drone link's ECCM against jamming is at least
Rule.URR_V80__magCastDice: Spell success test dice: Sorcery (book), or the spell's Force (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magElementalTn: Ranged manipulation (elemental) spells: fixed TN (0 = the spell's own TN, book; Revamp 4)
Rule.URR_V80__magRuleOfOneDrain: Disaster on a casting test: + this to the drain TN (book 0; Revamp 2)
Rule.URR_V80__magSpellTie: Tie on a damaging spell: no effect (book), or the caster wins at L (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magSustainCap: Spells a magician sustains: no limit (book), or at most the Sorcery rating (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magExclusiveForce: Exclusive spells take effect at + this Force, drain at normal Force (book 0; Revamp 2)
Rule.URR_V80__magFetishForce: Fetish spells take effect at + this Force, drain at normal Force (book 0; Revamp 1)
Rule.URR_V80__magLearning: Learning a spell: Sorcery vs Force (book), or Sorcery + Magical Theory vs 2 × Force (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magRitualTeamCap: Ritual team: at most as many members as the lowest Sorcery among them (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magRitualNoCombat: No combat spells by ritual sorcery (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magRitualCircle: Hermetic rituals need a hermetic circle, not a sorcery library (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magRitualMaterials: Ritual materials: per Force (book), or by category: detection and illusion 100¥, health 500¥, manipulation 1,000¥ × Force (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magSpotterDrain: A ritual's spotter resists the drain too (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magRitualResistTn: Resisting a ritual spell: vs the Force (book), or the higher of Force and the leader's Sorcery (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magConjDrain: Conjuring drain: Physical over Magic (book), or L below half Charisma, Physical over Charisma (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magNatureOneOnly: Only one nature spirit in service at a time (warned; Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magProjFullHours: Projecting: only full hours over the limit cost Essence (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magAstralDamage: A magician's astral attack: Charisma M (book), or unarmed L, weapon focus + rating M (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magTrackRating: Astral tracking: −2 TN when the Force is at most your Sorcery, +2 when higher (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magAstralDrainPhysical: Drain from spells cast while projecting is Physical (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magWardDrain: Ward drain: Force ÷ 2 (book), or Force + successes, Stun (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magWardMaxForce: Ward Force at most this × the team's Magic (0 = no limit, book; Revamp 2)
Rule.URR_V80__magSiteCost: Libraries and circles: price × rating, a day per rating (book), or library rating² × price, circle an hour per rating (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magAspectedNoAstral: Aspected sorcerers and conjurers can't perceive or project astrally (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magAdeptFoci: Physical adepts can use only weapon foci (Revamp)
Rule.URR_V80__magLossLe: Magic loss test: lose a point on 2D6 below Magic (book), or at or below Magic (Revamp)
Rule.SHOP_V91__buying: Buying in the shop: find first (an Availability test, then Buy or Haggle on the card) or buy now (the old way, no test); the GM, NPCs and creation always buy now
Rule.SHOP_V91__retry: A failed find: try again after its base Availability time (VERIFY) or at once (the old way)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findByLegality: Legality in the shop: a restricted or forbidden item is harder and slower to find openly (graded, VERIFY) or legality doesn't change the find (off, the old way)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findTn__restricted: Finding a restricted item openly: TN + (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findTn__forbidden: Finding a forbidden item openly (when the GM sells them): TN + (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findTime__restricted: Finding a restricted item openly: time × (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findTime__forbidden: Finding a forbidden item openly: time × (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__permits: Permits: bought with Get a permit… (a cost and a wait; the Permit box is the GM's) or the owner ticks the Permit box (tick, the old way)
Rule.SHOP_V915__permitCost__permit__share: A permit (Needs a permit): share of the item's cost (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__permitCost__permit__minimum: A permit (Needs a permit): at least ¥ (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__permitCost__restricted__share: A permit (Restricted): share of the item's cost (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__permitDays__permit: A permit (Needs a permit) comes through after days (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__permitDays__restricted: A permit (Restricted) comes through after days (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findTn__permit: Finding an item that needs a permit openly: TN + (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V915__findTime__permit: Finding an item that needs a permit openly: time × (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V916__through: Finding through contacts: a contact helps the find (as legwork) or a fixer finds it for a cut and more time (on, VERIFY) or every find is the character's own (off, the old way)
Rule.SHOP_V916__contactLegalShare: Through a contact: share of the legality TN row (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V916__fixerLegalShare: Through a fixer: share of the legality TN row and its time (0 = none; VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V916__fixerFee: A fixer's cut: share of the price (VERIFY)
Rule.SHOP_V916__fixerDicePerLevel: A fixer with no dice of their own: dice per contact level (VERIFY)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__required: Spell formulas: out of creation a character learns a spell only from a formula they hold, a teacher, the group's grimoire or their own design (on, VERIFY) or the shop's Learn needs nothing more (off, the old way)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__raise: Spell formulas: raising a known spell's Force needs a formula or teacher of the new Force (on) or not (off, the old way)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__nuyenPerForce: A formula's price per point of Force (VERIFY)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__tnPerForce: A formula's Availability TN per point of Force (VERIFY)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__availDays: A formula's Availability time in days (VERIFY)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__foreign: The other tradition's formula or teacher: a harder, slower learning test (harder, VERIFY) or no difference (same)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__teacher: Teachers: a character who knows the spell gives their Instruction successes (up to their Sorcery) as learning dice (on, VERIFY) or no teachers (off)
Rule.FORMULA_V918__feePerForce: A teacher no player plays: fee per point of Force (VERIFY)
Rule.MAGIC_V920__poolLayers: The Spell Pool in layers: Sorcery's rating for any magical action, the concentration's and specialization's extra dice only inside them (layered, the creator's interpretation) or one pool of Sorcery's rating (flat, the old way)
Rule.MAGIC_V920__castNarrow: A casting or dispelling test inside Sorcery's concentration or specialization rolls its rating (on) or always Sorcery's rating (off, the old way)
Rule.MAGIC_V920__drainNarrow: The narrow Spell Pool dice left may pay for that casting's Drain (on) or Drain takes general dice only (off)
Rule.SHEET_V921__tweaks: Custom tweaks on items count (on) or are kept but ignored (off)
Rule.SHEET_V921__carried: Weapons, armor and gear not ticked Carried have no weight, aren't searched and can't be used (on) or the tick is ignored (off, the old way)
Rule.SHEET_V921__accessories: A weapon's description is read for accessories when it arrives or is edited, filling only fields still at their default (auto) or never (off)
Rule.SHEET_V921__wizard: The creation wizard warns but never refuses (advise) or greys out and clamps as before (block)
Rule.SHEET_V921__ratingLock: After creation, players may type higher ratings unless the approval queue is on (queue) or never may (always, the old way)
Rule.CLOCK_V922__bigJump: A big jump of world time outside combat (a calendar setting the date): the GM is asked whether it counts as time passed or only changes the date (ask) or it always counts (count, the old way)
Rule.CLOCK_V922__bigJumpDays: A big jump of world time: at least this many days, forward or back
Rule.MATRIX_V923__systemTests: System tests: opposed (the decker needs more successes than the host's Security Value roll, VR2), or 1+ successes succeed (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__initiative: Persona speed: book (own Reaction + 2 per Response Increase, RI at most MPCP ÷ 4, hot DNI as one more level, tortoise half Reaction), or Intelligence-based (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__icInitiative: IC initiative dice: book (rating + 1/2/3/4 D6 Blue to Red), or v0.92.2's 1/1/2/2/3
Rule.MATRIX_V923__passiveAlert: Passive alert: + this to every subsystem rating (VR2: 2; 0 = none, v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__crashTally: Crashing IC adds to the attacker's security tally: its rating (VR2), half its rating, or nothing (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__shutdown: Host shutdown lasts 1D6 per 2 points of Security Value turns (VR2), or a fixed number of turns (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__operations: System operations: VR2's table (tests, utilities, actions; Locate File adds up 5 successes), or v0.92.2's
Rule.MATRIX_V923__cybercombat: Cybercombat: book (utility rating dice, TN by security code and status, IC resist and maneuver with Security Value, party IC modifiers, cripplers opposed), or v0.92.2
Rule.MATRIX_V923__actions: Cybercombat attacks and maneuvers: Simple Actions (VR2), or Complex (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__icDamageLevel: IC damage level: by the host's security code (VR2), or the IC's own (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__iconHardening: Hardening against icon damage: none (VR2: it protects the deck and the decker), or it lowers the Power (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__overload: Simsense overload: any white or gray IC damage on a hot deck, TN by level (VR2), or Serious+ vs the Power (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__dumpShock: Dump shock: a cool deck and an ICCM each −2 Power and −1 level, and any jack-out without a Graceful Logoff risks it (VR2), or neither (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__blackIc: Black IC: Body (lethal) or Willpower (non-lethal) less Hardening, no Hacking Pool, the icon resists too, holds only after a hit (VR2), or v0.92.2
Rule.MATRIX_V923__psychotropic: Psychotropic IC: one test at jack-out, cyberphobia + the IC's rating, lasts until recovered (VR2), or a test on every hit (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__grayIc: Gray IC: Hardening raises the Blaster/Sparky Test's TN, sparky's damage stages up, damaged chips must be replaced (VR2), or v0.92.2
Rule.MATRIX_V923__probe: Probe IC: rolls with every System Test (reactive, VR2), or only when the GM acts with it (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__trace: Trace IC: Trace Factor, 10 ÷ successes rounded down, reports only, survives a jack-out (VR2), or v0.92.2
Rule.MATRIX_V923__logoff: Graceful Logoff: leaves the Matrix with no dump shock and stops a trace (VR2), or moves to the parent grid (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__connections: Jackpoints: VR2's Access modifiers on Access tests only (and Trace Factor), or the connection's TN on every Matrix test (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__armorWear: Armor utility loses a point: only when it fails to absorb the whole hit (VR2), or every hit (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__shield: Shield utility: a parry against attacks (VR2), or soaks black IC damage (v0.92.2)
Rule.MATRIX_V923__frames: Frames: dumb frames use the owner's Computer, carried utilities' ratings total ≤ the frame's (VR2), or v0.92.2
Rule.MATRIX_V923__deckBuilding: Deck parts: VR2's design sizes and TNs, or v0.92.2's
Rule.MATRIX_V923__otaku: Otaku: VR2's living persona (MPCP and Masking rounded up, Hardening, Reaction (I + W) ÷ 2, 3D6), or v0.92.2's
Rule.MATRIX_V923__paydata: Paydata: 5,000¥ a point with VR2's sizes and defenses, or v0.92.2's per-Mp table
Rule.MATRIX__download__ioPerTurn: I/O speed × this = Mp moved per Combat Turn (VR2: 3, Mp per second; v0.92.2: 1)
Rule.MATRIX__attributeDamage__minOnHit: Crippler/ripper: at least this many points on any hit (VR2: 0; v0.92.2: 1)
Rule.MATRIX__utilitySize__kinds__smart-frame: Smart frame core size multiplier (VR2: 3; v0.92.2: 5)

any.system__essenceShift: Essence drained (negative) or gained (positive) by critter powers; added before cyberware.
any.system__magic: The Magic attribute. Capped by Essence (or reduced by Essence lost: a house rule).
any.system__initiateGrade: Initiate grade: +1 Magic per grade, plus centering, shielding and masking strength.
any.system__reactionBonus: Extra Reaction from anything not on the sheet as an item.
any.system__initiativeDiceBonus: Extra initiative dice from anything not on the sheet as an item.
any.system__monitor__physical: Physical damage boxes marked. 10 = dying; overflow beyond Body = dead.
any.system__monitor__stun: Stun damage boxes marked. 10 = unconscious; further Stun overflows into Physical.
any.system__poolSpent__combat: Combat Pool dice spent this Combat Turn (refreshed at the start of each turn).
any.system__poolSpent__hacking: Hacking Pool dice spent this Combat Turn.
any.system__poolSpent__control: Control Pool dice spent this Combat Turn (only usable jumped in).
any.system__karma__pool: Karma Pool: re-roll failures, avoid disasters and buy successes. Refreshes per session or combat (house rule).
any.system__karma__good: Good Karma to spend on skills, attributes, spells and initiation.
any.system__karma__career: Karma earned in all; every so much raises the Karma Pool.
any.system__nuyen: Cash on hand. Spending and earning go through the ledger on the Upkeep tab.
any.system__lifestyle__level: Lifestyle: sets the monthly bill. Pay it on the Upkeep tab.
any.system__astral: Physical, perceiving (+2 TN on physical tests) or projecting (astral form, Essence × 2 hours).
any.system__aspectElement: An elementalist's element: only its spell category and its elementals.
any.system__totem__name: Your totem. Its bonus and penalty dice are set per spell category and for Conjuring below.
any.system__totem__environment: Environment tags where the totem is strong (matched against the scene's tags).
any.system__totem__inEnvironment: Dice added to Sorcery and Conjuring in the totem's environment.
any.system__totem__outEnvironment: Dice added (negative: taken away) outside it.
any.system__spellDefense: Spell Pool dice set aside this Combat Turn: added to every spell resistance.
any.system__vision__lowLight: Natural low-light vision (as an elf or ork): partial and minimal light count as less dark. Cybereyes and goggles come from their items and use the cybernetic column.
any.system__vision__thermographic: Natural thermographic vision (as a dwarf or troll): darkness and smoke matter less; thermal smoke still blinds. Cybereyes and goggles come from their items.
any.system__professionalRating: NPC Professional Rating: sets the morale test.
any.system__grunts__size: How many identical grunts this sheet stands for. The next steps in when the front one goes down.
any.system__grunts__down: How many of the group are down so far.
any.system__shapeshift__enabled: A shapeshifter: the human form's attribute changes are set below.
any.system__shapeshift__form: The form it is in now.
any.system__weaknesses: Weaknesses in words; allergies and vulnerabilities that do something are Power items.
any.system__powers: Powers in words; powers that roll are Power items.
any.system__handling: Handling: the TN of driving tests, before terrain and maneuver modifiers.
any.system__speed: Top speed (in the same units as current speed). Above it, maneuvers are harder.
any.system__signature: Signature: the TN of sensor tests against this vehicle.
any.system__pilot: A drone's Pilot rating: rolled on autopilot; autopilot Reaction is rating × 2.
any.system__sensor: Sensor rating: dice for sensor tests.
any.system__ecm: Electronic countermeasures: added to the TN of sensor tests against this vehicle.
any.system__eccm: Counter-countermeasures: lowers the TN of this vehicle's sensor tests.
any.system__ecd: Electronic countermeasure detection: notices other vehicles' scans.
any.system__currentSpeed: Current speed: crash Power, ramming and moving-vehicle modifiers come from it.
any.system__drone: A drone: rolls Pilot on autopilot and can be subscribed to a remote control deck.
any.system__chase__metres: The gap to the vehicle this one chases, in metres.
any.system__matrix__sim: Hot sim: one more level of Response Increase (+2 Reaction, +1 die) and simsense overload; a cool deck softens dump shock and turns lethal black IC to Stun.
any.system__matrix__connection: How you connect: anything but a jackpoint adds to Matrix TNs.
any.system__availability: Availability, e.g. 6/48 hrs: TN and base time to find it.
any.system__streetIndex: Street Index: the price multiplier on the street.
any.system__toxin__addictionType: Physical addictions test Body; mental ones test Willpower, against the addiction rating (+1 per dose in the last week).
any.system__toxin__incubationHours: Hours from infection until the disease first tests its victim.
any.system__toxin__intervalHours: Hours between the disease's tests once it has taken hold.
any.system__toxin__recoveries: Tests without damage needed to throw the disease off (0 uses the house-rule default).
any.system__toxin__contagious: How a carrier passes it on: airborne to everyone close by, by contact or by blood to the people they target.
any.system__protection__kind: Gas masks stop inhaled toxins; respirators add their rating in dice against inhaled toxins; chemsuits against contact toxins.
any.system__protection__rating: Dice the respirator or chemsuit adds.
any.system__concealability: The TN to find it when searching or scanning. Weapons and worn armor at 0 can't be hidden; other gear and cyberware at 0 aren't looked for (scanners still find cyberware).
any.system__scanner__kind: A scanner: weapon detector, cyberware scanner or explosive sniffer. Search with it from the Search quick action.
any.system__scanner__rating: Dice the scanner rolls against each item's Concealability.
any.system__threatRating: Threat Rating: dice added to this NPC's Combat Pool (house rules; check the book).
any.system__reputation__streetCred: Street Cred (Shadowrun Companion): set by hand when it isn't worked out from career Karma.
any.system__reputation__notoriety: Notoriety: bad things the street remembers about this character.
any.system__reputation__publicAwareness: Public Awareness: how well known the character is to the public.
any.system__tradition: Hermetic, shamanic, adept, aspected; toxic and insect shamans when that house rule is on. Shamanic traditions follow a totem.
any.system__greatForm: Invoked into a great form spirit: a bonus to every attribute and to its powers (house rules).
any.system__metamagic__cleansing: Cleansing: lower the background count where you are (perceiving or projecting).
any.system__metamagic__divining: Divining: ask a question of the future; the GM answers with the clarity the successes give.
any.system__metamagic__invoking: Invoking: turn one of your nature spirits or elementals into a great form spirit.
any.system__metamagic__possessing: Possessing: while projecting, take over a body (opposed Willpower tests).
any.system__metamagic__reflecting: Reflecting: resistance successes beyond the caster's bounce a spell back at them.

spirit.system__force: The spirit's Force: its attributes are Force plus the adjustments; it also stands in for Essence and Magic.
spirit.system__services: Services the spirit still owes. 0 = it is free to leave.
spirit.system__spiritKind: Nature spirit, elemental, watcher, ally or free spirit.
spirit.system__domain: A nature spirit's domain: it is outside it when the scene's environment tags don't include it.
spirit.system__element: An elemental's element: aid spells, sustain spells and its secondary effects.
spirit.system__materialized: Materialized spirits can be hit by weapons; unmaterialized ones only astrally.
spirit.system__immuneNormalWeapons: Adds 2 × Force to armor against weapons that aren't magical.
spirit.system__spiritEnergy: A free spirit's Spirit Energy: added to its Force when resisting banishing.
spirit.system__trueName: A free spirit's true name (text only).

vehicle.system__body: Body: resists damage; crash damage and ramming scale with it.
vehicle.system__armor: Armor: weapon Power at or below it does nothing; above it, it comes off the TN.
vehicle.system__objectResistance: A spell's TN against this vehicle (0 = the house-rule default). Mana spells can't affect vehicles.
vehicle.system__autosofts__maneuver: Maneuver autosoft: dice added to driving tests the vehicle's own autopilot rolls.
vehicle.system__autosofts__targeting: Targeting autosoft: dice added when the autopilot fires a mounted weapon.
vehicle.system__autosofts__clearsight: Clearsight autosoft: dice added to sensor tests with nobody at the controls.

host.system__securityValue: Security Value: the host's detection dice, its IC's attack and resistance dice, and dump shock's Power.
host.system__securityCode: Security code: sets IC initiative dice and damage level, the cybercombat TNs, dump shock's level and the paydata it holds.
host.system__tally: Security tally: the host's detection successes so far. Sheaf steps fire as it rises.
host.system__alert: Alert level: only rises on its own; security deckers can cancel it.
host.system__gridKind: A host, or an LTG or RTG that other nodes hang off.
host.system__parentUuid: The grid this node hangs off. Hops between grids take travel time.
host.system__ltgNumber: This node's LTG number: a decker who dials it logs on from anywhere.

site.system__tally: The site's security tally: detections and failed bypasses raise it.
site.system__alert: Alert: active calls the response; lockdown locks linked doors.
site.system__response__force: Who responds when the alert goes active.
site.system__hostUuid: The Matrix host this site's devices are slaved to.

ic.system__rating: IC rating: its Power and the TN for tests against its effects (the host's Security Value is its attack dice).
ic.system__category: White, gray or black IC. Black IC damage the decker's own body.
ic.system__behavior: What it does when it acts (the hint below explains it).
ic.system__initiativeDice: Initiative dice; 0 = from the host's security code.
ic.system__kind: IC, or a decker's frame or agent.
ic.system__payload: Psychotropic IC: what it does to the decker's mind.
ic.system__guards: Barrier IC: the subsystem it blocks until crashed or decrypted.
ic.system__traceMode: What a completed trace does under the old house rule: dump, report the location, or dump and burn the deck (VR2's trace only reports).
ic.system__attribute: Crippler and ripper: the persona program they go after.
ic.system__smart: A smart frame adds pool dice.
ic.system__party: IC with the same party name in this host can attack together: +1 TN per member on their attacks and on attacks on them.

barrier.system__rating: The barrier's rating now; forcing through lowers it.
barrier.system__baseRating: Its full rating, restored by Restore.

weapon.system__skill: The skill it attacks with (Quickness at +4 TN without it).
weapon.system__specialization: The specialization it pre-ticks in the Attack dialog.
weapon.system__melee: A melee weapon: opposed melee test, reach and Strength-based Power.
weapon.system__reach: Reach: the longer weapon gets −1 TN per point of difference.
weapon.system__damagePower: Power: the damage resistance TN before armor (or the bonus over Strength).
weapon.system__damageLevel: Damage level before staging: each 2 net successes raise it a level.
weapon.system__modes: Firing modes, e.g. SA/BF/FA. Burst adds +3 Power; full auto adds Power per round.
weapon.system__recoilComp: Recoil compensation: cancels that much recoil TN.
weapon.system__ammoType: The ammunition loaded: APDS, explosive, gel and the rest change Power and armor.
weapon.system__smartgun: Smartgun-equipped: with a smartlink implant, −2 TN (Smartlink-2: more).
weapon.system__magical: Magical: ignores spirits' immunity to normal weapons.
weapon.system__weight: Weight in kilograms, for carrying load.
weapon.system__antiVehicle: Anti-vehicle: full Power and level against vehicles (others are halved).
weapon.system__mount: On a vehicle: who can fire it (fixed: the driver; turret: anyone; pintle or ring: a gunner). Fixed and turret mounts halve recoil; a pintle compensates 2, a ring mount 6.
weapon.system__range__extreme: Extreme range limit in metres (TN 9); beyond it the shot is refused.
weapon.system__laserSight: Pre-ticks the Laser sight row in the Attack dialog when the target is within the laser's range; it doesn't add to a smartlink.
weapon.system__scope: Imaging scope magnification: moves the range band closer like cyber-eye magnification (the better of the two counts).
weapon.system__scopeVision: The scope's own vision mode: low-light or thermographic counts for ranged attacks with this weapon, as if the shooter had it.
weapon.system__shockPad: A shock pad: always adds its recoil compensation.
weapon.system__support: A bipod or tripod: recoil compensation once set up (an action from the weapon row), or when firing prone.
weapon.system__supportSetUp: Set up: the bipod or tripod's recoil compensation counts.
weapon.system__fuse: Impact: goes off where it lands. Airburst: bursts in the air, scattering less; neither can be thrown back.
weapon.system__smartGrenade: With a smartlink, each attack success takes more metres off the scatter.

armor.system__ballistic: Ballistic armor: against bullets and other ranged attacks.
armor.system__impact: Impact armor: against melee, blasts and falls.
armor.system__parry: A shield: its Parry rating helps every melee defense (dice, or off the TN: house rules).

cyberware.system__essenceCost: Essence cost before grade (alpha, beta and delta cost less).
cyberware.system__grade: Grade: lowers the Essence cost and raises the price.
cyberware.system__kind: What kind of implant: limbs, weapons, jacks, eyes, ears and reflexes each have their own rules.
cyberware.system__initiativeDice: Initiative dice it adds (capped in all).
cyberware.system__armorBallistic: Ballistic armor it adds (dermal plating and the like).
cyberware.system__bioware: Bioware: costs Body Index instead of Essence.
cyberware.system__bodyIndex: Body Index cost; the total is limited by natural Body.
cyberware.system__controlRig: Vehicle control rig rating (needed to jump in).
cyberware.system__cultured: Cultured bioware: costs more; some kinds must be cultured.
cyberware.system__rating: Rating where the item has one: skillwires (activesoft cap), encephalon (dice), headware memory (Mp), ICCM filter (dice), bioware (effect).

spell.system__category: Spell category: which foci, totem dice and aspect rules apply.
spell.system__spellType: Mana spells are resisted with Willpower and work astrally; physical spells with Body.
spell.system__learnedForce: The Force it was learned at: the highest Force it can be cast at.
spell.system__damageLevel: Combat spells: the base damage level, staged by net successes.
spell.system__targetNumber: Non-combat spells: the TN of the casting test.
spell.system__duration: Instant, sustained (+2 TN while held) or permanent.
spell.system__area: An area spell: Force × 1 m around the target.
spell.system__resist: The attribute an unwilling target resists a non-combat spell with.
spell.system__exclusive: Exclusive: drain TN −2, but nothing else while casting.
spell.system__fetish: Fetish-limited: drain TN −1; needs the fetish in hand.
spell.system__elemental: An elemental manipulation: a ranged attack with the element's side effect.

focus.system__focusType: Spell, sustaining, spirit, power or weapon focus.
focus.system__rating: Its rating: the dice it adds.
focus.system__active: Only active, bonded foci help (and count towards addiction).
focus.system__bonded: Bonding costs Good Karma = rating × the type's cost.

power.system__dice: Where the dice come from: Force, the rating below, Magic or an attribute.
power.system__rating: The power's own rating, when dice come from it.
power.system__tnSource: The TN: a fixed number, or the target's attribute.
power.system__resist: What the target resists with (or not at all).
power.system__effect: Damage staged by net successes, or only the net successes reported.
power.system__special: A built-in effect: allergy, vulnerability, Essence loss or drain, regeneration, dual-natured, infection (a bite passes on a disease).
power.system__sustained: A sustained power: its effect (attribute changes below) lasts until the user drops it or is knocked out.
power.system__perSuccess: Multiply the attribute changes by the net successes (capped by a house rule).

adeptpower.system__level: The power's level, for powers bought in levels.
adeptpower.system__special: A built-in effect: killing hands, combat sense, pain resistance, enhanced or astral perception.

cyberdeck.system__mpcp: MPCP: caps each persona program; sets the Hacking Pool.
cyberdeck.system__hardening: Hardening: comes off the Power of Matrix damage.
cyberdeck.system__responseIncrease: Response Increase: +2 Matrix Reaction and +1 initiative die per level (max 3).
cyberdeck.system__activeMemory: Active memory: the loaded programs must fit in it.
cyberdeck.system__storageMemory: Storage memory: downloaded data must fit in it.
cyberdeck.system__ioSpeed: I/O speed: how fast downloads go.
cyberdeck.system__active: Only the deck in use counts.
cyberdeck.system__tortoise: A tortoise (no ASIST): half Reaction, less Hacking Pool, no hot sim; black IC and dump shock can't reach the user.
cyberdeck.system__living: An otaku's living persona: ratings from the otaku's attributes (house rule).

program.system__kind: The utility's kind: decides which operations it helps and what it does.
program.system__rating: Its rating: lowers the subsystem TN, or is the attack Power.
program.system__size: Size in Mp; 0 = from the book formula.
program.system__loaded: Only loaded programs work; they use active memory.

gear.system__medkitRating: A medkit's rating: dice added to first aid.
gear.system__rcdRating: A remote control deck's rating: drones it can run (rating × 2).
gear.system__stealth__rating: The suit's rating: how much harder it makes cameras (chameleon) or thermal sensors (thermal masking) work.
gear.system__stealth__worn: Only a worn suit hides its wearer from security devices.
gear.system__jammer: A jammer's rating: dice to jam a drone's remote link (Jam quick action).

skill.system__attribute: The linked attribute: used when defaulting and to group the skill.
skill.system__specialization: A narrower field; its rating replaces the skill's when it applies.

theNumberIsTheStepsBetween.one: (the number is the steps between them; 1 if left out). Lines starting with # are notes. Defaulting to a related skill costs +{perStep} TN per step along the shortest path, up to {maxSteps} steps; skills with no path {part}. With no links at all, every related skill is +{skillDefaultTnMod}. {count} link now.
theNumberIsTheStepsBetween.other: (the number is the steps between them; 1 if left out). Lines starting with # are notes. Defaulting to a related skill costs +{perStep} TN per step along the shortest path, up to {maxSteps} steps; skills with no path {part}. With no links at all, every related skill is +{skillDefaultTnMod}. {count} links now.

Settings.whoSeesEachKindOfTest: Who sees each kind of test you roll, by default. "Foundry's chat mode" follows the mode chosen under the chat box. Cards someone else must answer (Defend, Resist, a blast) stay public.
Settings.changesApplyForEveryoneStraightAway: Changes apply for everyone straight away; open sheets refresh when re-rendered. Every value comes from
Settings.anyOtherRuleByItsPath: Any other rule by its path, as JSON, e.g.
Settings.theFieldsAboveWinOverThe: . The fields above win over the same path here.
Settings.eachLineSaysWhyCheckThe: (each line says why): {problems}. Check the house rules window.
Settings.canOnlyDefaultToTheAttribute: can only default to the attribute

ofTheRulesBelowDifferFrom.one: {count} of the rules below differs from its default now.
ofTheRulesBelowDifferFrom.other: {count} of the rules below differ from their default now.

Settings.rulesSourceRevamp: Rules source: {source} — it changes {value} rules under your house rules; {bySourceSize} of them are rows here (marked, and found by searching "revamp"). Your values below still win.
Settings.rulesSourceConfigure: Rules source: {source} (Configure Settings, SR2e system: Rules source).
Settings.sr2eHouseRulesTheAdvancedBox: SR2e house rules: the advanced box is not valid JSON.

Tours.thisIsYourCharacter: This is your character. The top shows your picture, name and metatype. Most things on the sheet have a tooltip: hover to read it.
Tours.theStripAtTheTop: The strip at the top stays in view while you scroll: your condition monitor (Physical, Stun and Overflow), wound modifier, initiative, pools (click a pip to set how many dice are left), your readied weapon (click it to attack) and, in a fight,
Tours.withTheActionsYouHaveLeft: with the actions you have left. The layout picker in the sheet's tools switches between Tabs, Combat column and Compact.
Tours.searchFindsAnyRow: Search finds any row on the sheet.
Tours.modeHidesTheAdd: mode hides the add, delete and copy buttons and locks most fields, so you can't change things by accident during a fight;
Tours.inTheCompactLayout: (In the Compact layout the tabs are folding sections down the sheet.)
Tours.hasYourAttributesAndSkills: has your attributes and skills with roll buttons.
Tours.isAReadOnlySummary: is a read-only summary of everything as it stands now. Combat, Magic, Matrix and Rigging hold those parts of the game; Gear, Upkeep (lifestyle, money, things under way) and Bio the rest.
Tours.onAListHeading: on a list heading opens the Add window: pick from the GM's catalogue, then add free, buy with nuyen or learn with Karma. The
Tours.afterAHeadingOpens: after a heading opens the player guide at that topic.
Tours.everyAttributeFromItsBase: Every attribute from its base to what it is now (hover to see why), your pools, Essence, armor, Karma and what changed since creation.
Tours.trainingLearningASpell: Training, learning a spell, an order on its way: they show under
Tours.onTheUpkeepTab: on the Upkeep tab and finish when game time has passed. You can give one up and get its cost back.
Tours.clickASkillOrAttribute: Click a skill or attribute to roll it. Target a token first (T over it) and every target-number modifier the system can find is filled in for you; you can switch any of them off in the dialog. Hold
Tours.toRollAtOnce: to roll at once without the dialog. Results come as chat cards with Defend, Resist and Karma re-roll buttons.
Tours.everythingForRunningTheGame: Everything for running the game, in tabs: the scene, combat, the party, NPCs, the world, tools, the log, players' requests and setup.
Tours.theSystemLogsItsOwn: The system logs its own changes while you have the world open: undo takes them back one step at a time (
Tours.theLogTabSays: ). The Log tab says what it can't undo.
Tours.backgroundCountWeatherTerrain: Background count, weather, terrain, darkness and environment for the viewed scene, regions with an SR2e environment, and presets to put it all back in one click.
Tours.everyonesMonitorsAndPools: Everyone's monitors and pools, refresh buttons, awards, money and Karma, and what is under way (change its time or finish it now).
Tours.whatToDoAtTheStart: What to do at the start and end of each session. The buttons on a line do that step; tick lines as you go and start a new session to clear them.
Tours.giveEachPlayerTheirCharacter: Give each player their character, then set up the party's tokens in one click: linked, Physical and Stun bars, vision from their eyes and cyberware.
Tours.bundlesOfItems: Bundles of items: make one from a sheet, drop more items on it, give it to several actors at once. Players find kits in the Add window.
Tours.pasteRowsFromASpreadsheet: Paste rows from a spreadsheet to make many item templates at once, export them as CSV, or save a catalogue file (templates and kits) to load in another world.
Tours.aTabForEachKind: A tab for each kind of thing. The list holds the system's generic templates and the GM's own first, then world items and compendiums.
Tours.searchTickWhatYouWant: Search, tick what you want, and set how many (or the rating) on the row.
Tours.freeCharacterCreation: Free (character creation, a GM gift, loot), buy with nuyen, or learn with Good Karma. Things with an Availability time are ordered and arrive later (Upkeep → Under way).
Tours.theCharacterSheetTheSummary: The character sheet: the summary, tabs, Edit and Play, adding things, rolling.
Tours.theAddWindowFinding: The Add window: finding, ticking and paying.
Tours.theGmPanelTheSession: The GM panel, the session checklist, players and tokens, kits and the catalogue.

Chat.itHitsAWallAndDrops: It hits a wall and drops there.
Chat.itLandsMOfTheTargetPoint: It lands {metres} m {direction} of the target point (scatter {n}d6 = {total} m{successes}{extras}).
Chat.wallInTheLineOfFire: Wall {n} in the line of fire

Print.shadowrun2ndEditionUnofficialFor: Shadowrun 2nd Edition (Unofficial) for Foundry VTT, sr2e {sysVer} · printed {date}. Unofficial fan system: Shadowrun and Matrix are trademarks of The Topps Company, Inc.

Setup.lootPilesMerchantsAndTrading: Loot piles, merchants and trading between characters: nuyen, prices and quantities set up by SR2e.
Setup.aTokensHealthInWords: A token's health in words from the worse of its Physical and Stun tracks (vehicles: condition; IC: Matrix monitor).
Setup.attacksSpellsSkillsAndPools: Attacks, spells, skills and pools from the selected token.

Catalogue.pasteRowsToSeeWhatThey: Paste rows to see what they make.
Catalogue.onlyTheGmCanLoadA: Only the GM can load a catalogue.
Catalogue.onlyTheOwnerCanImportInto: Only the owner can import into this character.
Catalogue.sCreationIsFinishedAskThe: {name}'s creation is finished: ask the GM to import into it.
Catalogue.theApprovalQueueIsOnAsk: The approval queue is on: ask the GM to import it.
Catalogue.pasteACharacterWriteUp: Paste a character write-up: Name, Metatype, the attributes (a B Q S C I W E M R row, or lines like "Body 5"), Skills, Knowledge and Language skills, Cyberware, Bioware, Spells, Adept powers, Gear (weapons with damage codes, armor 5/3, "Medkit ×2"), Contacts, Edges and flaws, Nuyen, Karma, Lifestyle and Notes. Items with the same name as one on the sheet are updated. Check the result: guesses (linked attributes, Essence costs) are listed.

Ui.everyNpcTokenOnTheScene: Every NPC token on the scene
Ui.isSetOffByTheGm: is set off by the GM

Adding.readyToUseInstalledWornBonded: ready to use (installed, worn, bonded, loaded)
Adding.theApprovalQueueIsOnThis: The approval queue is on: this goes to the GM, who approves it before it is added and paid.
Adding.theApprovalQueueIsOnFree: The approval queue is on: free adds go to the GM too.
Adding.inCharacterCreation: In character creation: everything here counts against the Resources nuyen (the wizard keeps the cash in step).
Adding.inCharacterCreationFocus: In character creation: everything here counts against the Resources nuyen (the wizard keeps the cash in step). A bonded focus also takes its bonding Karma from the starting spell points.
Adding.learningTestsAreOn: Learning tests are on: each spell rolls {skill}, and the Karma is paid on success.
Adding.eachSpellCostsItsForce: Each spell costs its Force in Good Karma.
Adding.filedWithACostButIts: filed with a cost, but its data adds it free
Adding.itCostsKarmaNowWas: it costs {now} Karma now, {filed} was filed
Adding.vehicleNoKey: A vehicle in the request doesn’t say which one (it can’t be bought this way).

Approvals.isNotSomethingARequestMay: "{method}" is not something a request may do
Approvals.itsDataIsNotAPlain: its data is not a plain record

Npcgen.name: Name
Npcgen.withTokensOnTheViewedScene: , with tokens on the viewed scene
Npcgen.createsTheCritterActorGroup: Creates the critter actor (a group of {grunts} on one sheet){tok}.
Npcgen.createsTheNpcActorGroup: Creates the NPC actor (a group of {grunts} on one sheet){tok}.
Npcgen.writesAGmJournalEntryPeople: Writes a GM journal entry and creates its three people.
Npcgen.writesAGmJournalEntryHost: Writes a GM journal entry and its Matrix host.
Npcgen.writesAGmJournalEntryPeopleHost: Writes a GM journal entry and creates its three people and its Matrix host.
